AGENDA

OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

1.
Waive Further Reading
Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption on second reading.
2.
Adoption/Second Reading of Ordinance 16-718 as it Pertains to Administrative Citations for Code Enforcement Violations
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No. 16-718, on second reading, adding a new Chapter 1.50 to Title 1 of the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code regarding administrative citations.
Staff Report
3.
Resolution R16-35; Calling for Election of Certain City Officers and Resolution R16-36; Requesting the County Board of Supervisors to Have the County Registrar/Recorder Provide Certain Services for the Conduct of the City's General Municipal Election –March 7, 2017
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R16-35 calling for the election of City officers for a term of 3 years and 8 months, and Resolution R16-36 requesting the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors to have the County Registrar/Recorder provide election services and approve consolidation if a special election is called.
Staff Report
4.
Resolution R16-37; Regarding Foreign Language Translations and Establishing a Deposit Fee for Candidate Statements
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution R16-37 regarding candidate statements and foreign language translations and establish the candidate statement deposit fee in the amount of $300 for the March 7, 2017 General Municipal Election.
Staff Report
5.
PW-641-16; Award of Construction Contract for Removal of Unpermitted Structure and Miscellaneous Debris from Lunada Bay and Adoption of Resolution R16-38 Adjusting the FY16-17 Budget
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council award a contract for the removal of unpermitted structures and miscellaneous debris from Lunada Bay in the amount of $61,511.00 to AMPCO Contracting, Inc., along with authorization of the $6,151.00 10% contingency, and adopt Budget Resolution R16-38 adjusting the FY 16-17 budget for a total project cost of $67,662.00.
Staff Report
6.
Special Event Application for the Lexus LaceUp Running Series Palos Verdes Marathon Scheduled for Saturday, November 19, 2016
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the request and fees charged to allow the Lexus LaceUp Running Series Palos Verdes to travel through Palos Verdes Estates on Saturday, November 19, 2016 from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.
Staff Report
